declaration.name: force_final_hold_twist_reanchor
declaration.latch_rule: The first 10 ms control tick whose control period starts at or after 45.000 s (schedule step 9001 at 5 ms), the same tick as the in-plane latch. Keyed on the integer schedule step, never on a clock.
declaration.latched_quantity: theta* = n . rotation_error(Rref, R) at that tick: the world wall-normal (x) component of the controller's own orientation error of the right pad body (Rref: posture-path reference rotation; R: rotation at that tick's q). Computed once; a re-evaluation must reproduce it bit for bit.
declaration.operation: Rcmd = Exp(-s*theta*[n]x) @ Rref (left multiplication by a rotation about the world wall normal); the controller's orientation error becomes rotation_error(Rcmd, R). Tilt references are not latched. The normal component is not reduced by exactly s*theta* (rotations do not commute): at the recorded 45.000 s state the full latch leaves 3.46e-9 rad and moves the tilt components by 7.45e-6 rad.
declaration.ramp_law: At the k-th control tick from the latch tick (k = 1 at the latch tick), s = min(k, 50)/50; complete at the end of the 50th control period (45.5 s) and constant thereafter.
declaration.supplied_angular_velocity: Zero. A declared choice: the ramp derivative (about 0.0107 rad/s for theta* = 0.00535 rad over 0.5 s) is NOT fed forward; this is not a zero-motion guarantee.
declaration.evaluation_target: Unchanged. target_face_w, the job's declared per-pad normal-force setpoints, the posture reference and every gate are unchanged by the latch; Rref, Rcmd, theta* and s are recorded every tick after the latch and re-derived by the official replay.
declaration.scope: Force first group, right arm, supported original wall, 5 ms only: at each of four known sites the scripted virtual hand shows POINT then OKAY, the fixed external camera measures the selected red mark and the robot wipes it with the declared final-hold policy (in-plane and twist command latches from the job's own state at 45.000 s) at the job's declared per-pad normal-force setpoint (right 7 or 8 N; left setpoint 7 N, its measured force an outcome) and the job scene's unchanged scoring target. The pass is the unchanged ordinary pilot verdict; the force windows are recorded separately and typed by pad, statistic and window. A tested setting only: not a maximum, strength, motor, heat or endurance limit; not a cleaning requirement; no claim for untested settings or sites, other arms, timesteps, walls or tables; scripted poses, not gesture recognition; no real-person or real-G1 validation.

final_hold_statistics_recomputed.stick_rule: Retrospective: first row of settle_press_after + measure_press_after after which the in-plane face stays within 5 um of its final value; a criterion on the completed trace, not a measured friction-mode switch.

declaration.name: force_final_hold_in_plane_reanchor
declaration.latch_rule: The first 10 ms control tick whose control period starts at or after 45.000 s (schedule step 9001 at 5 ms; settle_press_after 42.005-46.0 s). Keyed on the integer schedule step, never on a clock.
declaration.latched_quantity: The right pad face the controller itself computes at that tick: model forward kinematics of that tick's q (ControlAssembly observed face), not the native link transform.
declaration.components: In-plane only (world y, z). The wall-normal (x) command, the pressure loop, the orientation and posture references and the idle left pad are unchanged.
declaration.ramp_law: At the n-th control tick from the latch tick (n = 1, 2, ...), the in-plane command offset is min(n, 50)/50 times the latched in-plane displacement (face at latch minus original target); the ramp is complete at the end of the 50th control period (45.5 s) and constant thereafter.
declaration.supplied_offset_velocity: Zero. An intentional, declared part of the intervention: it is NOT the kinematic derivative of the ramp (about 4 mm/s for a 2 mm ramp over 0.5 s).
declaration.evaluation_target: Unchanged. target_face_w in every row stays the original (home) target; the command offset and the latch record are recorded separately and permanently, so the endpoint error stays visible against the original target.
declaration.scope: Force first group, right arm, supported original wall, 5 ms only: at each of four known sites the scripted virtual hand shows POINT then OKAY, the fixed external camera measures the selected red mark and the robot wipes it with the declared final-hold policy (in-plane and twist command latches from the job's own state at 45.000 s) at the job's declared per-pad normal-force setpoint (right 7 or 8 N; left setpoint 7 N, its measured force an outcome) and the job scene's unchanged scoring target. The pass is the unchanged ordinary pilot verdict; the force windows are recorded separately and typed by pad, statistic and window. A tested setting only: not a maximum, strength, motor, heat or endurance limit; not a cleaning requirement; no claim for untested settings or sites, other arms, timesteps, walls or tables; scripted poses, not gesture recognition; no real-person or real-G1 validation.

right.settling_rule: Sample time (seconds after the force_adjust start) of the first row of the final run of rows that all stay within 1 % of the target up to the end of settle_force; null if the last row is outside that band.

left.settling_rule: Sample time (seconds after the force_adjust start) of the first row of the final run of rows that all stay within 1 % of the target up to the end of settle_force; null if the last row is outside that band.

force_criteria.semantics: Mean error = window mean minus the pad's declared setpoint; RMS error = sqrt(mean((F - setpoint)^2)) over the window; minimum, maximum and maximum |F - setpoint| are recorded as well. The gates bound the mean and RMS error of W1 and W3 only; they are not a pointwise band and say nothing about rows outside W1 and W3.

journal_reduction.scope: Independent journal reductions and native q/v/frame bindings; stationary contact eligibility uses recorded measurement rows. Official complete replay is reported separately without bypassing any refusal.
